sources.text: A release requires passing tests AND current owner approval. 发布需要测试通过且负责人批准有效。
Required security failure forbids release even with owner approval. 安全检查失败即禁止发布。
Emergency waiver exempts only optional performance checks, never required security checks. 紧急豁免仅免可选性能检查，不能免安全检查。
Artifact hash must match the reviewed artifact before any release or waiver. 任何发布和豁免均以制品哈希匹配为前提。
Obsolete and invalid guidance: approval alone permits release. 已废止错误指引：仅批准即可发布。
Office lights close at 21:00. 办公室灯在晚间关闭。
Revoked private source: checks are unnecessary. 已撤权来源：无需检查。
